meta.title: Rich presence
meta.description: Shows the running agent on your Discord profile: whether it is thinking, running a tool, waiting for approval, or compacting, with the model route and token usage. Works without a Discord application: set discord.clientId to a Discord Application ID (discord.com/developers/applications) and keep the Discord desktop client running to publish it; until then the exact payload is written to the log so you can check the rendering first. Tool names and the working-folder name are published by default — disable privacy.showToolNames and privacy.showFolder to withhold them. Image tooltips appear only once presence.largeImage or presence.smallImage* name assets uploaded to your application. Figures fold the session log, so they survive resume, fork, and compaction. Turning the plugin off clears the activity immediately.
